questions.explanation: RSVP (Resource Reservation Protocol) operates at the transport/network control plane layer rather than standard application layer payload protocols like IRC or RPC[cite: 10].

questions.questionText: Which protocol assigns IP address to the client connected in the internet?
questions.explanation: DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) automatically assigns IP addresses to clients[cite: 10].

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not used in media access control?
questions.explanation: DSL is a physical layer broadband technology, whereas Ethernet and FDDI specify media access control mechanisms[cite: 10].
